newsitem.title: UK: Derwent Valley buys two London properties.
newsitem.headline: Derwent Valley buys two London properties.

text.p: Property investment company Derwent Valley Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it has bought two central London properties from the London & Manchester Assurance Group for 20 million stg.
The consideration for the two properties, situated close to the capital's Soho Square area, will be met from bank facilities, Derwent Valley said in a statement.

"These properties, which occupy a busy retail location on Oxford Street and present opportunities to utilise the group's lease management and refurbishment skills, will be a beneficial addition to the group's portfolio," the statement said.
